title: GitHub - mrscraper-com/mrscraper-mcp: Official MrScraper MCP server: Scraper API for HTML, Markdown, and screenshots, web search, and account usage for AI agents.
snippet:
An MCP server exposing the seven MrScraper services through hosted HTTP or local stdio.
## Overview
Seven services share the same descriptions, parameter meanings, and defaults across the CLI, SDKs, and integrations. Names, types, authentication, and code examples follow each surface's conventions. See the [API Reference](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/api/overview).
| Service | Public name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Status | `status` | Return the raw account status API response without summarizing, redacting body fields, or adding calculated fields. |
| Scrape HTML | `scrapeHtml` | Retrieve the raw HTML of a page. Browser rendering is optional. |
| Scrape Markdown | `scrapeMarkdown` | Retrieve a page as Markdown. Including HTML also enables browser rendering and returns both outputs as JSON. |
| Get screenshot | `getScreenshot` | Capture a base64 screenshot of the full page or top viewport. Browser rendering is always enabled. |
| Scrape brand | `scrapeBrand` | Extract a website's colors, typography, logos, and social links as JSON. |
| Scrape JSON | `scrapeJson` | Extract structured JSON from a page using a natural-language prompt. Append Json Schema: and a JSON schema to shape the output. |
| Web search | `webSearch` | Search the web and return ranked results with titles, URLs, descriptions, and sources. |
## Installation
The hosted server requires an MCP client with Streamable HTTP support. Local execution requires Node.js 20 or newer.
Configure the hosted endpoint in your MCP client:
```
{ "mcpServers": { "mrscraper": { "url": "https://mcp.mrscraper.com/mcp" } } }
```
For local stdio, configure the client to start `npx -y @mrscraper/mcp@latest`. The full configuration is in Integration features.
## Authentication
Obtain an API key from [the MrScraper app](https://app.mrscraper.com/api-tokens). API key used to authenticate the request.
The hosted server supports browser sign-in through OAuth 2.1. Approve `account:read` for status and `scrape:read` for all six scraping/search tools. Connections that already hold `scrape:read` keep working; others must reconnect and approve it for scraping/search.
Clients without OAuth can send an API key as `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`. Local stdio reads `MRSCRAPER_API_KEY`, then `MRSCRAPER_API_TOKEN`. Tools do not accept tokens as arguments.
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"mrscraper": {
"url": "https://mcp.mrscraper.com/mcp",
"headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" }
}
}
}
```

# MCP Server
Access MrScraper’s web scraping API via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to enable AI agents to fetch and extract web data securely.
Use MrScraper’s web scraping API through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to let AI agents discover, fetch, and extract web data in real time. This cloud-hosted MCP server integrates directly with MrScraper, enabling secure, scalable scraping workflows without local setup or infrastructure management.
## Features
### AI Scraping
### Geo Unblocker
### Scraper Execution
### Bulk Scraping
### Results Management
### Rotating Proxies
### Cloud MCP Server
## Installation
### Prerequisites
To use the MrScraper MCP server, you'll need:
1. [A MrScraper account](https://v3.app.mrscraper.com/auth/login)
2. [MrScraper Account API Key](/docs/getting-started/api-token#generating-an-api-token)
### Remote Hosted URL via HTTP Transport Protocol
The simplest way to use MrScraper MCP is through our remotely hosted server. No local installation required!
